summary: Repository layout is coherent for a Windows desktop app, but scoped cleanup remains before it should be considered structure-clean.
active_objective: Finish safe repository structure and cleanliness hardening without broad functional refactors.
assumptions: Primary production target is Windows 10 1809 or newer / Windows 11 with PowerShell 7 for repository operations.
npm is the frontend package manager because src/OnlyRag.Web/package-lock.json is present.
Generated build, dependency, test, and packaging outputs should stay ignored rather than tracked.
decisions: Keep verification centered on scripts\Invoke-Gate.ps1 -Configuration Release.
Do not remove ignored artifacts automatically when they may contain current local validation evidence.
Do not split oversized source or test files in a structure audit unless the responsibility boundary is obvious and low-risk.
current_tasks: Review remaining oversized source, style, script, and test files and split only where responsibilities are clear.
Decide whether ignored artifacts\ollama-resilience-audit.md should be deleted, moved into docs, or retained as local evidence.
Keep .gitignore aligned with generated outputs, local editor state, and secret-bearing environment files.
Confirm certificate handling keeps private signing material outside the repository.
next_tasks: Run scripts\Invoke-Gate.ps1 -Configuration Release before implementation or release handoff.
Run scripts\Clean.ps1 when local build/test/dependency outputs are no longer needed.
Run installer lifecycle validation only on a clean Windows verification machine when packaging is in scope.
blockers: Signed installer lifecycle validation requires Inno Setup, signtool, a trusted signing certificate, and a clean Windows verification machine.
Live Ollama, WebView shell, and OCR GPU validation require representative local runtime environments.
risks: Several files exceed review thresholds and may hide mixed responsibilities until explicitly split.
Ignored artifacts may contain useful local evidence or stale reports; removal policy needs a project decision.
Full production readiness cannot be proven from structure cleanup alone without the canonical gate and external runtime validation.
structure_notes: Solution layout is coherent for a Windows WPF shell, in-process API, shared core contracts, infrastructure adapters, worker abstractions, Vite React UI, packaging, scripts, docs, and tests.
Generated outputs are ignored: artifacts, packaging\qdrant\payload, bin/obj, src\OnlyRag.Web\dist, node_modules, test-results, coverage, and Playwright reports.
certificates\app now has a local README clarifying that private signing material must not be stored in the repository.
.gitignore now covers common Windows/editor state, temporary files, backup files, and local environment files.

external_services: Optional local or trusted-LAN Ollama endpoint

commands.test: dotnet test .\OnlyRag.sln --configuration Release --no-restore; Set-Location .\src\OnlyRag.Web; npm run test

last_completed_work: Performed scoped repository structure cleanup: removed temporary web test/typecheck output, hardened .gitignore, and documented certificate folder safety.
open_questions: Should ignored local audit artifacts be retained as evidence, moved into docs, or deleted during cleanup passes?
handoff_notes: Run the canonical Release gate before handoff. Treat release/package readiness as blocked until signed installer lifecycle and representative external runtime validations are recorded.
